meta.name: circleci-automation
meta.description: Automate CircleCI tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): trigger pipelines, monitor workflows/jobs, retrieve artifacts and test metadata. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 通过 Rube MCP 自动触发流水线、监控工作流与获取构建产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常需要管理 CircleCI 流水线并希望自动化重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate CircleCI pipelines, monitor workflows, and retrieve artifacts via Rube MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage CircleCI pipelines and want to automate repetitive tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动触发 CircleCI 流水线、监控工作流和作业状态、获取构建产物和测试结果。
howto.when: 当你要求查看或操作 CircleCI 项目（如触发构建、检查流水线状态、获取测试报告）时触发。

say.text: 帮我触发 myorg/myrepo 的 main 分支流水线。
列出 myorg/myrepo 最近的流水线。
say.note: Claude 会调用列出流水线工具并返回列表。

say.text: 获取作业 123 的测试元数据。
say.note: Claude 会调用获取测试元数据工具并返回测试结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can trigger CircleCI pipelines, monitor workflow/job status, and retrieve build artifacts and test metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view or operate on CircleCI projects, such as triggering builds, checking pipeline status, or fetching test reports.

say_en.text: Trigger a pipeline on main branch for myorg/myrepo.
say_en.note: Claude will call the trigger pipeline tool and return the pipeline ID.
Claude will call the list pipelines tool and return the list.
Claude will call the get test metadata tool and return test results.
